name: Echo-Haunt
damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
description:
An Echo-Haunt is the remnant of a person or purpose that died too close to Numillian's warded secrets, leaving behind a shape made of memory, sound, and unfinished intent. At a glance it resembles a thin, humanlike figure draped in shredded veils of pale light, its body half-present and half-dissolved into rippling air. Its face is indistinct, as though seen through frosted glass, but when it turns, a second version of its silhouette lags behind it by a heartbeat or repeats in fractured layers across nearby stone. Faint whispers trail from it in overlapping voices: scraps of warnings, ledger numbers, prayers, and the last words it heard before it was bound.

Echo-Haunts drift through ruins and sealed chambers without touching the floor, their movements as quiet as dust settling. They are drawn to inscriptions, memory-slates, ward-lines, and places where secrets were hidden too long. When disturbed, they do not simply attack; they replay the moment of their death in violent flashes, filling the air with ghostly footsteps, slammed doors, and disorienting echoes that make every corridor feel longer and every shadow more crowded. Their presence chills lantern light and stains polished stone with a faint silver haze, as if reality itself is remembering something it should have forgotten.
